evidence:
Observed 2026-09-24 on the implementation tree of the qualification child
`01a0bd36-8421-7b57-9ac1-c083a2b66993`, based on `main` at
`e67b1854c39ca902d331490886e8d9fc296c4e97` and committed on
`feat/mem-adaptive-qualification`. All five children are done. The
qualification child's five mandatory acceptances were each recorded by
`just devloop gate` through the `just-target` gate with execution input
`{"justTarget": "private_memory_phase5_check"}` (the inventory matrix on both
architectures over the complete phase-4 surface), all `passed: true` in one
run epoch recorded on that item, and the child was closed by
`just devloop complete`. A green baseline of `just private_memory_phase4_check`,
`just sel4_loan_check` and `just sel4_gate_control_check` was observed on
unmodified `e67b185` before implementation.

The qualification exposed and fixed five runtime defects that no fixed or
single-inventory plane could reach: a pool-relative window sized from the pool
free at bind time rather than the admitted pool, so a holder spawned under
pressure received an empty window for life; guarantees subtracted from the
elastic pool twice, stranding their envelope; returned extents reusable only
at their original size, so base-page growth after a bulk holder exited was
refused with most of the pool free; root CSlots priced as a fixed inventory
although the root CSpace grows from the same bytes; and record tables bounded
by a compile-time 4096-page directory, which capped trackable base pages near
2 GiB. The root also no longer treats an ARM ordinary inventory below the
retired 1 GiB window as fatal; the pinned product image's gate still requires
it. Rationale: `docs/architecture/private-memory.md`, "Device-derived capacity".

Exit conditions, as observed on QEMU 11.0.1, one CPU:

- **Same policy and binaries, three inventories per architecture.** Each row is
  its own seL4 kernel, device tree, platform description and loader
  (`sel4/pins.toml` `inventory_memory_mib`); one closure-built root and
  component set is packaged byte for byte with every row, the pinned row's
  repackaged image equals the closure image, and each row's installed libsel4
  equals the envelope's. Normalized device-tree dumps are required
  byte-identical twice per build; the RISC-V discrepancy was uninitialized
  alignment padding in QEMU's dump, removed by a `dtc` re-emission. Verified
  resident payload (bulk schedule, first and last word of every page written
  zero-checked and re-read) grows with the row and exceeds 1 GiB on both
  expanded rows.

| Row | Kernel memory | Ordinary | Admitted pool | Resident bulk / all-small / mixed (pages) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ARM 1 GiB (constrained) | 536870912 | 514021744 | 487868288 | 120126 / 119899 / 120118 |
| ARM 2 GiB (pinned) | 1610612736 | 1587763568 | 1561610112 | 382267 / 381532 / 382254 |
| ARM 4 GiB | 3758096384 | 3735247216 | 3709093760 | 906554 / 891700 / 893276 |
| RV64 1 GiB (constrained) | 1071644672 | 1051059136 | 1025028576 | 251267 / 250787 / 251259 |
| RV64 3 GiB (pinned) | 3219128320 | 3198542784 | 3172512224 | 775552 / 765480 / 766877 |
| RV64 4 GiB | 4292870144 | 4272284608 | 4246254048 | 1037695 / 1019447 / 1021335 |

- **Exact exhaustion.** Bulk, all-small and mixed simultaneous holders each walk
  to a refused single page, halving after every refusal so each refusal is
  followed by a still-fitting request that is served. Every refusal names its
  resource with the ledger and allocator residuals and an elastic census; at
  the final page the allocator residual never exceeds the 16 MiB operational
  reserve. Bulk ends at the ledger pool on every row; all-small and mixed end at
  the ledger pool on the constrained and ARM pinned rows and at ordinary layout
  on the larger rows, with small-page capacity 0.2-2 % below bulk, the
  difference being leaf tables, CSlot leaves and descriptor metadata.
- **Contention and guarantees.** An idle pool-relative holder bound before the
  bulk walk does not shorten it and is itself refused under pressure without
  harm; a guaranteed holder redeems the second half of its promise at
  exhaustion and is refused its first page past it; a spawn under exhaustion is
  funded by the operational reserve. Denied subjects, duplicate incarnations,
  the over-guaranteed composition, IO-window collisions and the repeated
  two-boot request schedule remain covered by `just private_memory_adaptive_check`;
  malformed, unsupported and overflowing policies by host tests and
  `just system_spec_check`; device memory by a runtime check that every ordinary
  range lies inside the kernel's compiled memory; launcher-only RAM by booting
  each architecture's pinned kernel with 4 GiB, which changed no inventory,
  pool or residency figure.
- **Failure and lifecycle.** Twenty coordinated cycles per row alternate victim
  holder and fault/exit ending; a different holder then receives and zero-checks
  the same 4095 pages while the guaranteed peer re-reads its whole pattern, and
  the root census after every cycle equals the pre-cycle census field for field.
  Injected construction, revoke, acquisition, retype, mapping and near-limit
  descriptor failures, revoke-failure quarantine with exactly one retry, CSpace
  and metadata limits, and shared-buffer loans ran in the same recipe through
  the adaptive-lifecycle, rollback, conservation, cspace, metadata, bootstrap
  and loan arms. Revoke-failure retry and shared-buffer operations were not
  exercised inside the twenty matrix cycles themselves.
- **Fixed regressions.** The complete phase-4 surface (fixed capacity,
  isolation, stress, cycles, bootstrap and small-profile boundaries) passed
  within the same `private_memory_phase5_check` runs.

The ARM root is `cfa9724777720b4b…` and the RV64 root `d7e793cf2b3490d6…` on
every row of their architecture; kernel, device-tree and loader digests differ
per row, and the pinned rows' kernels and device trees equal the
`observed_prefix` pins. Also passed: `just test_sel4_root` (323/323),
`just test_host`, `just fmt_check_all`, `just lint_all`, `just ruff`,
`just typos`, `just docs_check`, `just contracts_check`,
`just system_spec_check`, `just system_image_builder_check`,
`just component_crate_split_check`, `just tasks_check` and
`just sel4_gate_control_check` (45 gates plus 9 adaptive arms, 2760 rejected
mutations, including 24 matrix controls for still-fitting refusals, invented
fit, missing costs, census drift and cross-row identity).

Every result is a QEMU envelope on two architectures; no physical board's
inventory or capacity is qualified, and each board still needs its own
inventory rows and runtime observation. Raw serial transcripts are local
diagnostic artifacts at `build/sel4-private-memory-matrix{,-rv64}-mem*.log`
and `build/sel4-private-memory-matrix{,-rv64}-launcher-only.log`; their hashes
above are the retained identity, not an archival claim.
